risks.risk: Optical issues not visible in these angles (fungus, haze, internal scratches, or coating damage).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the front element and rear element at an angle with bright light, plus a photo of the lens against a flashlight for haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed perfect optics (worst case: may need cleaning or has minor optical defects).

risks.risk: Autofocus/IS (if applicable) and aperture/zoom mechanics may be faulty even if it looks clean.
risks.proof: Video or short clip showing AF focus on a subject through the camera, plus a zoom-in/zoom-out test and aperture actuation (camera display showing aperture changes).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst case: treat as needing service / not fully functional).

risks.risk: Mount compatibility mismatch (Canon mount type could be different, or lens may not seat properly).
risks.proof: Photo of the lens mounted on the exact Canon body (showing it fully seated) and a shot of the camera confirming it detects the lens.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as Canon-compatible only if proven; otherwise treat as compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Exact Sigma model variant not fully confirmed (some 12-24 variants differ by generation/features).
risks.proof: A photo of the full model text/serial label on the lens barrel (sharp, readable) or the box/receipt label if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common value for the 12–24mm Sigma Canon-mount category until the exact variant is confirmed.
